fact: RFI reports PPA-CI activist Mamadou Zigui was arrested on 2 September 2025 after a social-media video about the Constitutional Council's candidate-list deliberations.
RFI reports the Abidjan court sentenced PPA-CI activist Gala Kolebi on 30 June 2025 to 18 months and a 500,000 CFA franc fine for disturbing public order and spreading false news.
The opposition party PPA-CI, through Justin Kone Katinan, publicly denounced the arrest of its activist as a violation of freedom of expression.
Cote d'Ivoire's prosecutor says a nurse was sentenced on 18 July 2025 to 36 months in prison and a 5 million fine for an outrageous social-media comment about a state institution.
